title: ML-KEM (Kyber) Deployment
description: Deploys ML-KEM, the NIST-standardized lattice KEM, for quantum-safe key exchange. Kyber's balanced sizes and speed won the NIST competition; FIPS 203 standardizes it. It is the default PQ key exchange.

demo.title: Demo — ML-KEM (Kyber) Deployment

title: FrodoKEM Conservative Choice
description: Uses FrodoKEM's conservative unstructured-lattice design where caution outweighs size. Bigger keys buy stronger security assumptions; some deployments prefer the margin. It is the belt-and-suspenders KEM.

demo.title: Demo — FrodoKEM Conservative Choice

title: Hybrid X25519+Kyber
description: Combines X25519 with Kyber so sessions are safe unless both break. The hybrid secret mixes classical and PQ shares; deployed by browsers and CDNs today. It is the pragmatic migration.

demo.title: Demo — Hybrid X25519+Kyber

title: KEMTLS Handshakes
description: Replaces TLS signatures with KEMs in the KEMTLS design, shrinking PQ handshakes. Long-lived KEM keys authenticate; no online signatures needed. It is the future shape of PQ TLS.

demo.title: Demo — KEMTLS Handshakes

title: PQ Key Size Planning
description: Plans for PQ key and ciphertext sizes in protocols and storage. Kyber public keys are ~1.5KB versus 32 bytes for X25519; buffers, MTUs, and databases must grow. Size surprises break deployments.

demo.title: Demo — PQ Key Size Planning

title: Side-Channel Resistant KEMs
description: Implements KEMs with constant-time code to resist timing and power analysis. Reference implementations are not always constant-time; hardened versions are audited. Side channels break math that is otherwise sound.

demo.title: Demo — Side-Channel Resistant KEMs

title: NIST FIPS 203 Compliance
description: Complies with FIPS 203 for ML-KEM in regulated deployments. Approved parameters, validated modules, documented usage — the compliance checklist. Federal systems require it.

demo.title: Demo — NIST FIPS 203 Compliance

title: PQ Migration Strategy
description: Plans the enterprise migration: inventory crypto, prioritize, pilot hybrids, then cut over. Cryptography inventories reveal the scope; hybrids de-risk the transition. It is a multi-year program.

demo.title: Demo — PQ Migration Strategy

title: PQ Performance Benchmarks
description: Benchmarks PQ algorithms on target hardware to size the migration. Keygen, encaps, and decaps costs vary widely; measurements pick parameters and hardware. Data beats assumptions.

demo.title: Demo — PQ Performance Benchmarks

title: Known-Answer Testing
description: Validates PQ implementations with known-answer tests from the standards. KAT vectors catch implementation bugs before deployment; every release runs them. It is table stakes for crypto code.

demo.title: Demo — Known-Answer Testing

title: Hybrid Negotiation
description: Negotiates hybrid key exchange in protocols with graceful fallback. Peers advertise PQ support; both sides agree or fall back cleanly. Negotiation must resist downgrade.

demo.title: Demo — Hybrid Negotiation

title: PQ Certificate Handling
description: Handles PQ certificates with bigger keys and new OIDs in PKI. Chains grow; verifiers must parse new algorithms; hybrid certs ease transition. PKI is the long pole of migration.

demo.title: Demo — PQ Certificate Handling

title: Protocol Integration (TLS/SSH)
description: Integrates PQ key exchange into TLS, SSH, and WireGuard deployments. Each protocol has its integration story; the work is configuration and testing more than cryptography. Pilots prove it works.

demo.title: Demo — Protocol Integration (TLS/SSH)

title: Downgrade Protection
description: Protects PQ negotiation from downgrade to classical-only. Attackers who strip PQ offers must not succeed; the handshake authenticates what was offered. TLS 1.3's design helps.

demo.title: Demo — Downgrade Protection

title: Crypto Agility Programs
description: Builds crypto agility so algorithms swap without rewrites. Abstract interfaces, algorithm registries, and tested migration paths make the next transition cheap. Agility is the lesson of every migration.

demo.title: Demo — Crypto Agility Programs
